nodes.label: Grammar: 可能补语 V得/不+Complements (Complements of Possibility)
Grammar Note: 比较句2 A比B+Adj+一点儿/一些/得多/多了 (degree of difference)
得 de (particle introducing a complement of result/degree)
Pronunciation: Trisyllabic "Stressed + Light + Light" structure (重轻轻格式, very few, mostly colloquial): first syllable stressed, others light, e.g. 什么的, 怪不得, 姑娘家, 好着呢
Grammar: 比 Sentence (1) expressing difference (specific Num-M; 一点儿/一些 slight; 多/得多 significant)
Grammar: Complement of Degree with an object (object before verb, or verb reduplicated: S + (V+) O + V + 得 + Adj)
Grammar: Complement of Degree negative form (negative word after 得: V + 得 + 不 + Adj)
Grammar: Complement of Degree interrogative form (V + 得 + Adj + 不 + Adj)
他说得好不好？ (Tā shuō de hǎo bu hǎo?) - Does he speak well? (interrogative form)
姐姐起得早不早？ (Jiějie qǐ de zǎo bu zǎo?) - Does elder sister get up early? (interrogative form)
你住得远不远？ (Nǐ zhù de yuǎn bu yuǎn?) - Do you live far? (interrogative form)
得 (de) - used after a verb or an adjective to introduce a complement of result or degree (part.; Lesson 12)

写得不错，除了这个句子意思有些不清楚外，其他都没什么问题。 (Xiě de búcuò, chúle zhège jùzi yìsi yǒuxiē bù qīngchu wài, qítā dōu méi shénme wèntí.) - It's well written; apart from the meaning of this sentence being a bit unclear, the rest has no problems.
